changelog: **Partner application keeps its confirmation on a language switch:** the switcher reloads the page, which dropped a sent `/partner/apply` form back to an empty one. The tab now remembers that it sent (a `sessionStorage` flag, never the typed values) and shows the confirmation in the new language.

en: After sending a partner application, switching the language keeps the confirmation instead of showing an empty form.
tr: Partner başvurusu gönderildikten sonra dil değiştirildiğinde boş form yerine onay mesajı görünmeye devam ediyor.
de: Nach dem Absenden einer Partnerbewerbung bleibt beim Sprachwechsel die Bestätigung sichtbar statt eines leeren Formulars.
